verdict.rationale: Temporal Cloud documents streaming metrics via an OpenMetrics endpoint into Datadog, Elastic, Grafana Cloud, New Relic, ClickStack, or self-hosted Prometheus. Its worker-performance guide covers Task Queue information and the metrics that drive Worker fleet efficiency. That covers the export half of the story, but the pack has no evidence of alerting on misbehaving workflows, and one user reports that workflows can sit 'in-progress' with errors buried in the event log and no programmatic way to respond. Missing for 10: documented alerting on workflow failures or anomalies, explicit coverage of failure-rate, latency and queue-depth metrics, metrics export for self-hosted deployments, and independent hands-on corroboration.
